ios.desc:
See the full picture, fast. Compare coverage across trusted sources, follow breaking updates, and read in a clean, distraction-free reader.

--Key features--
• Daily Brief: Summaries of top stories, updated throughout the day.
• AI Search: Ask questions, get instant answers backed by real articles.
• Compare Coverage: View how different outlets report the same story.
• Instant Alerts: Get real-time notifications for trending news.
• Save & Follow: Bookmark stories and track updates as they evolve.
• Explore by Topic: Politics, Technology, Business, Health, and more.
• Distraction-Free Reader: Clear headlines and a focused reading mode.
• Sync Across Devices: Your saved stories stay with you wherever you sign in.
• Free & Ad-Free: Enjoy all features without costs or clutter.

--Why Relative?--
We help you see beyond one source. By putting reputable reporting in one place and making comparison effortless, you get context, not spin.

Stay informed with multiple viewpoints, avoid sensationalism, and never miss a breaking story. Download Relative - news clarity starts here.

quotes.text:
Hi HN! A couple of friends and I recently built our first app together - Relative News, a news reader designed to help you stay informed without feeling overwhelmed or misled.

We were frustrated with how chaotic and exhausting most news apps can be. Instead of bombarding you with endless headlines, Relative groups related articles from multiple sources into "Stories." This way, you can easily follow a topic and see how different outlets are reporting on it. By presenting multiple perspectives side by side, we aim to reduce bias and help users form a more balanced understanding of the news.

Key features include:

- A clean, uncluttered feed that focuses on clarity.

- The ability to follow specific stories and receive notifications when there are updates.

- A straightforward interface that lets you compare coverage across various publications.

We're a small team passionate about improving how people consume news. This is our first app, and we know there's still a lot of room for improvement.

We'd genuinely appreciate any feedback or suggestions you might have.
